caption: Plant: Pepper bell. Condition: Bacterial Spot. Severity: Moderate to Severe. Pathogen: Xanthomonas spp. Small water-soaked lesions have turned dark brown with distinct yellow halos scattered irregularly across the leaf surface.
Plant: Pepper bell. Condition: Healthy. Severity: None. Pathogen: None. No disease symptoms are visible. Normal healthy growth is indicated by even green color and intact, undamaged leaf structure.

Plant: Potato. Condition: Early Blight. Severity: Mild to Moderate. Pathogen: Alternaria solani. Target-pattern lesions with dark brown rings and chlorotic halos are hallmark early blight symptoms on this leaf.
Plant: Potato. Condition: Healthy. Severity: None. Pathogen: None. No disease symptoms are visible. Normal healthy growth is indicated by even green color and intact, undamaged leaf structure.

Plant: Potato. Condition: Late Blight. Severity: Moderate to Severe. Pathogen: Phytophthora infestans. Dark necrotic regions with a greasy sheen and indistinct margins are spreading rapidly across this diseased Potato leaf.

Plant: Tomato. Condition: Target Spot. Severity: Moderate. Pathogen: Corynespora cassiicola. The leaf displays target-like spots with alternating dark and light concentric bands surrounded by yellowing tissue.

Plant: Tomato. Condition: Mosaic Virus. Severity: Severe. Pathogen: Tomato Mosaic Virus (ToMV). The Tomato leaf displays a patchwork of pale and dark green areas with slight wrinkling from mosaic virus.

Plant: Tomato. Condition: Yellow Leaf Curl Virus. Severity: Severe. Pathogen: Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus (TYLCV). The leaf shows severe yellowing and upward curling with reduced size from TYLCV infection.

Plant: Tomato. Condition: Bacterial Spot. Severity: Moderate to Severe. Pathogen: Xanthomonas spp. Small water-soaked lesions have turned dark brown with distinct yellow halos scattered irregularly across the leaf surface.

Plant: Tomato. Condition: Early Blight. Severity: Mild to Moderate. Pathogen: Alternaria solani. Target-pattern lesions with dark brown rings and chlorotic halos are hallmark early blight symptoms on this leaf.
Plant: Tomato. Condition: Healthy. Severity: None. Pathogen: None. No disease symptoms are visible. Normal healthy growth is indicated by even green color and intact, undamaged leaf structure.

Plant: Tomato. Condition: Late Blight. Severity: Moderate to Severe. Pathogen: Phytophthora infestans. The leaf shows large water-soaked lesions with dark brown necrotic centers and pale green halos, indicating rapid tissue collapse.

Plant: Tomato. Condition: Leaf Mold. Severity: Mild. Pathogen: Passalora fulva. The Tomato leaf exhibits chlorotic spots above with a felt-like olive-brown fungal coating on the corresponding lower surface.

Plant: Tomato. Condition: Septoria Leaf Spot. Severity: Moderate. Pathogen: Septoria lycopersici. Small circular spots with dark brown borders, lighter tan centers, and tiny black pycnidia dots are scattered across the leaf.

Plant: Tomato. Condition: Spider Mite Damage. Severity: Mild to Moderate. Pathogen: Tetranychus urticae. The upper leaf surface appears pale and stippled with yellow dots while fine silk webbing may be present beneath.
